Subject: Sync is live, decision needed by October 30th

Hi Dr. Patel,

The calendar and contacts sync is working. Before October 30th we need an answer from you on one thing.

Google wants a verification review for apps that read Gmail and Calendar data, and it's $540 a year. Your admin can also approve the app by hand for your own domain at no charge. That takes about ten minutes, and it's what I'd go with. It doesn't give anything up for a practice your size.

If that works for you, tell me and I'll send your admin the steps.

Best regards,
Nate Seluga
